business_summary: Look Holdings Incorporated engages in the apparel related, production and OEM, and logistics businesses in Japan, Korea, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company plans, manufactures, imports, exports, and sells men's and women's clothing and others; and provides logistics, storage, and inspection of manufactured products and merchandise. It sells its products through physical and online stores under the A.P.C., A.P.C. golf, CLAUS PORTO, IL BISONTE, IL BISONTE JEWELRY, IL BISONTE UOMO, KEITH, Marimekko, Repetto, SCAPA, and SMYTHSON brands. The company was formerly known as Look Incorporated and changed its name to Look Holdings Incorporated in January 2018. Look Holdings Incorporated was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

A.P.C., A.P.C. 하에 실제 매장과 온라인 매장을 통해 제품을 판매합니다. 골프, CLAUS PORTO, IL BISONTE, IL BISONTE JEWELRY, IL BISONTE UOMO, KEITH, Marimekko, Repetto, SCAPA 및 SMYTHSON 브랜드. 이 회사는 이전에 Look Incorporated로 알려졌으며 2018년 1월에 회사 이름을 Look Holdings Incorporated로 변경했습니다. Look Holdings Incorporated는 1944년에 설립되었으며 일본 미나토에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
